title: GM Staff and Roster Management Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Team_ReleasePlayerInternal (RVA 0x12d0340) updates roster count at [TeamFranchise + 0xee8], shifts remaining players, and sets the released player's team to free agency (0xffff).
claims.falsification_note: Waiving a player who has guaranteed salary still incurs dead money against team payroll unless cleared via stretch provision.

claims.statement: Staff_ValidateRoleAndDispatch (RVA 0x1327590) restricts assignable staff roles to roles 8 through 20 (add ecx, -8; cmp ecx, 0xc; ja invalid).
claims.falsification_note: A staff role cannot be arbitrary integer; must fall within 8..20 range.
